استدرجت (form X)

# اِسْتَدْرَجْتَ (istadrajta) /is.tad.rad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
# اِسْتَدْرَجْتِ (istadrajti) /is.tad.rad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
# اِسْتَدْرَجَتْ (istadrajat)
